requirements.description: For PEMS incorporated into an IT-NETWORK not VALIDATED by the PEMS MANUFACTURER, instructions made available

sub_items.description: Purpose of the PEMS connection to an IT-NETWORK
Required characteristics of the IT-NETWORK
Required configuration of the IT-NETWORK
Technical specifications of the network connection, including security specifications
Intended information flow between the PEMS, the IT-NETWORK and other devices on the IT-NETWORK, and the intended routing through the IT-NETWORK
A list of HAZARDOUS SITUATIONS resulting from failure of the IT-NETWORK to provide the required service
ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENTS for the RESPONSIBLE ORGANIZATION - statement that connection to IT-NETWORKS could result in previously unidentified RISKS TO PATIENTS, OPERATORS or third parties
Notification that the RESPONSIBLE ORGANIZATION should identify, analyse, evaluate and control these RISKS

semantic_fragments.content: For PEMS incorporated into an IT-NETWORK: the product under review is stated as 'Not be incorporated into an IT-NETWORK', therefore all IT-NETWORK related requirements under clause 14.13 are marked N/A.

All software change management requirements under clause 14.12 (Software Classification per IEC 62304 clause 4.3, Software Process per clause 5, RISK MANAGEMENT per clause 7, Configuration management per clause 8, Problem resolution per clause 9) are marked N/A, indicating no software changes have been assessed at this review stage.

PEMS VALIDATION independence requirement: The person with overall responsibility for PEMS VALIDATION must be independent of the design team, and no member of a design team is responsible for PEMS VALIDATION of their own design. All professional relationships of members of PEMS VALIDATION team with members of design team must be documented in the RISK MANAGEMENT FILE.
